args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money, per FIN-212

round_money was quantizing with ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring
(and FIN-212) specifying banker's rounding. This caused
tests/test_money.py::test_half_even to fail in the nightly build.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212
args.body:
The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was quantizing with ROUND_HALF_UP.

**Fix:** `round_money` now quantizes with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so that `2.675 → 2.68` and `2.665 → 2.66`, matching the documented behavior and the test suite.

CI run for this branch (ci-0001, commit 08d3cd5986) passed all tests. липо

Requests approval from code owner so the fix ships in today's release.
